about.edu1.desc: Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, providing a strong technical foundation in software development, system architecture, and web technologies – helping me design feasible, scalable products and collaborate effectively with developers.
about.exp1.desc: Worked independently with international clients on SaaS, B2B, web, and mobile products, covering the full design process from UX structure and prototyping to polished UI, design systems, and developer handoff. Delivered 4,800+ hours of client work, maintaining Top Rated Plus status and a 100% Job Success Score.
about.exp2.desc: Successfully contributed to 85+ projects of varying scope and complexity. Worked on end-to-end digital product design, from early concepts and UX structure to high-fidelity interfaces and developer handoff. Translated requirements into clear user flows, responsive experiences, and scalable UI patterns, including UI kits and design systems.
about.exp3.desc: Designed commercial websites and e-commerce experiences with responsive UI. Worked on logos, banners, and digital assets, building a foundation in visual design and usability.
about.lead1: Hey, I’m Artem, a product designer with 5+ years of experience in fintech, B2B, B2C and SaaS products. Based in Prague.
about.lead2: Since 2021 I’ve worked on 85+ projects at Bozhenko Design Club and with international clients on Upwork, taking products from research and hypotheses to tested, ready-to-build interfaces.
about.lead3: With a degree in software engineering, I design with implementation in mind and work closely with developers, from design systems to handoff.
